notes.title: Shadowhand Solitaire - Multi-Language Update
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/afa193882a6afa3257d6f6d873514bf160ed77f3.png"]

You can now change language for Shadowhand Solitaire on Steam via the options screen. 

Supported languages are: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, and Brazilian Portuguese.

Note: at present we have no plans to officially support more languages because we are an indie microstudio. But we welcome fan translations.

Enjoy playing Shadowhand Solitaire in your chosen language!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3199380/Shadowhand_Solitaire/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Announcing Shadowhand Solitaire! Wishlist Now.
notes.content:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33035039/0445c5eefb455b53c0d5a57a449e4395392029f8.gif
NEW GAME ANNOUNCEMENT!
Shadowhand Solitaire is coming very soon to Steam...
We're super proud of this swashbuckling solitaire adventure and we think you'll love it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3199380/Shadowhand_Solitaire/

Shadowhand Solitaire is a casual, solitaire-only edition of Shadowhand: RPG Card Game with no turn-based combat. Gameplay is similar to other hit games in the series: Regency Solitaire & Regency Solitaire II.
